reviews.title: A good flight with some challenging passenger behaviour
reviews.text: Providing information to Indian passengers in a language they could understand may help to facilitate the boarding process which was horrible due to ignoring instructions, line jumping, etc. The staff was extremely patient (and they needed to be). The food was delicious for an airline. I wish they would caption the movies shown on the in flight entertainment movies.
reviews.author: Tom F

reviews.title: What a nice surprise this airline was!
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise! We selected upgraded economy seats which were still cheaper than other carriers. Checked bags included. These seats were in a part of the cabin with only six rows. I was greeted by a smiling staff, and a pillow and headphones waiting on my seat. I was offered a choice of juice or sparking wine as I sat down. The plane was a Boeing 787 which departed on time. Hot meals with wine offered both ways with a snack before landing. Meal out of Italy of course was better than the one from New York. Movies, television, and music were offered. Service was always pleasant. Debarking at Malpensa was a breeze. Passport readers were electronic and quick. Trains to Milan were easy. There are a number of carriers that fly this route. This was the best value with a nearly new airplane. The airline is not as well known but is the second largest Italian carrier. I would not hesitate to use them on any of their routes throughout europe.
reviews.author: Neil K

reviews.title: All around excellent to and from NYC
reviews.text: i can't recall how I found NEOS online, but when i saw their variation of prices for different fares and what was included, i pulled the trigger and got 4 seats. I upgraded to the economy plus (row 5 through 10) just for a little more room, as it was only 80ish more per seat. i do not recommend row 5 if your tall or with a waistline greater than a 40US waist. , the seats are behind a bullhead and have the video screens embedded in the seats. so they get a big rigid. The staff was efficient for all of "economy" and they are all italian, so if you're english speaking only, you're going to be reduced to types of drinks and yes please and no thank you. plane was quiet, smooth and i will use them again!
reviews.author: Al H

reviews.title: Premiere Seats on Neos.. NOT ECONOMY
reviews.text: We were apprehensive to take this airline since we knew nothing about them. It was hard to find really good info on what exactly to expect. We flew their premier seats. You are allowed 2 checked bags approx. 60 lbs each. We checked in on the Web Check In 24 hours prior with no problem. When we got to Term 1 JFK the bag drop/check in is located at area C. We easily dropped our bags and they gave us another boarding pass. We quickly made our way through premier/1st class security line. Boarding starts 1 hour prior to departure. We easily walked right through the crowd to pre board with our premier seats. The airplane was clean, new and welcoming. The premier seats had a refreshing bag, pillow and blanket. USB, large TV screen and comfortable wide seat. Your footrest comes out and you recline to a very comfortable position. It is comparable to regular 1st class not Polaris. A drink was offered while boarding. Hot towels then Dinner was served and was surprisingly fairly good. Served on plates as a first class meal would be. They serve you in 3 courses.. your salad, entree then dessert. With more beverages served. Alcohol was all inclusive.. wine and beer is what we had. The staff was very accommodating from beginning to end. But we are generally very pleased and happy people.. maybe that helps. When you arrive in MXP, expect to walk down the portable stairs and take a shuttle bus. Our luggage came out in a timely manner and we rented a car that was easily done as well. I got a tip from a blogger to go on discovercars.com. And wow.. it truly saved us a ton of money. You make your reservation on the site. Pre pay a deposit and they send you a voucher for Sicily by car. The rates were accurate and there were no problems. Discovercars.com blogger recommended taking the full coverage by them and we did. We selected it through discovercars.com. I would highly recommend NEOS premier. We paid 1000.00 round trip per person and could not believe what a deal we got. Hope this helps. I can not speak for economy class.

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text: The flight was fine – the only flight I've taken that serves wine with the meal, which was a plus, and it's the first flight in a long time that took off on time and had enough overhead space for carry on bags. However, on our flight back from Milan to New York, they didn't have a record of us pre requesting 2 vegetarian meals, and the one "vegetarian" meal they gave us was actually vegan (I love cheese!) and when we asked them to clarify what was in the other meal they gave us instead, they kept insisting the cheese and spinach ravioli was not vegetarian but that they didn't have any "vegetarian" meals for us. For the rest of the flight, when drink and snack service was offered, they passed by us without asking what we wanted, and we didn't get that meal. Flight crew needs better training on different dietary restrictions and could have offered better service for the rest of the flight.

We took off late but that was traffic at the airport not a Neos problem. Before takeoff, the gate was moved at JFK and the gate agent made sure that anyone in the area knew about it (I had a gate be changed on TAP and barely made it to the correct gate because it was not well announced Customer service - well, I wish that there was an app for Neos. reviews.author: RMF333

reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text: Prior to flying this trip, we had not heard of NEOS before, so we were a bit hesitant to make a reservation. The prices were so inexpensive for this trip, we felt it might be one of those "too good to be true" situations. You know the type - you're promised the world and end up with a shocking disappointment... Well, it wasn't that way at all. From the very first person we saw (while checking in), every employee was considerate, friendly, and very professional. The airliner itself looked new, and everything was clean. I mean, really clean. We didn't feel like we had to "Chlorox Wipe" everything, even in the bathrooms - a welcome change from some airlines we have flown. We were also served a DELICIOUS MEAL. Those words don't usually go together when discussing airline food! But this was really tasty and the servings were plentiful. We've flown on one of the top rated (for food) airlines, and this meal was superior to the meals we've had on the top rated airline. We paid a whopping $22 for extra legroom, and we were quite comfortable on our trans-Atlantic flight. They provide (paid) wifi, but if you don't need to use the computer, the entertainment is comparable to most airlines. All in all, NEOS made the grade and then some. We've found our new favorite airline!

reviews.title: Everything leading up was not great but the flight itself was good.
reviews.text: So, at the end of the day, for the price, I can recommend this flight from Milan to NYC. I booked well in advance and was able to secure their most premium offering for $600. Flying abroad at that price in a premium cabin is not normal so I was both excited and skeptical. At first things were ok, I booked it online, printed my confirmation and created an account. Then the website glitched and I was never able to complete getting an email confirmation for my flight. My anxiety didn’t like that because I’m used to being able to check on my status with my flight as often as I’d like, But the day I purchased was the only day I could see that I actually had a spot on the plane. I tried to release that and just hoped that everything was still smooth and on time, but in the days leading up to me leaving Italy I tried to reach out to the airline to see if they could locate my res. Over about 2 days of verrrrry slow communication, they ultimately “did not see my reservation sorry” …….. what?! So then I spent the rest of my trip freaking out, and praying that I would walk up to check in and they would have record of me. That pre flight customer service almost makes this a 3 out of 5, I would hate to know what it would be like to cancel or reschedule etc. The best part about the flight itself was the food and the service. My ticket came with lounge access at the airport and it was very well stocked and tended to. Then on the plane I felt like I was eating the whole time! The plane is definitely not luxury, I never found any outlets, my hair stuck to the Velcro of the headrest, this not a new aircraft. But the service was great, the price was great and I was happy to arrive safely home.

I am not sure if you have read all my past emails but I hope you can check on them again so you'll realize how I was pleading during the previous months. I have repeated that I have valuable items in it all my clothes are there and I had to re-purchase most of them and I had to worry every single day about the current condition of my personal papers and belongings inside the luggage. You are imposible and your offer is very insulting. I have also read the Air Passenger Bill of Rights Worldwide Air Passenger Rights Montreal Convention 1999 (MC99) The Montreal Convention establishes airline liability and a modern compensatory regime for the victims of air disasters. A resolution was adopted following the 38th Assembly of ICAO member states in 2013. It encourages all states that have not yet done so to enact MC99. The Convention is designed to unify numerous international airline liability treaties. This helps to provide more transparent legislation regarding the international carriage of passengers, baggage and cargo. It is currently valid in the US, EU, 110 UN member states and 30 other countries. The Warsaw Convention 1929 Warsaw Convention defines “international carriage” and sets the rules for airline liability, limitations, and legal jurisdiction. It also requires that carriers issue baggage checks for checked luggage. The Convention also limits the liability of the carrier. Thus creating a limitation period of two years within which a claim must be brought (Article 29). Warsaw Convention amended in 1955 at The Hague, Netherlands, and in 1971 in Guatemala City, Guatemala. As of 2015, the Warsaw Convention had been ratified by 152 states. I Have had enough of this waiting Game Neos! I already sent necessary documents for settlement but you dont respond on my email.
